parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster.

parameters.name: Integration
parameters.description: The abbreviation of the software that is supported by ARMS. Valid values (case-insensitive): `ASM`, `IoT`, and `Flink`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms get-integration-state --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --integration asm --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms GetIntegrationState --region cn-hangzhou --Integration asm --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
